label: glm53-flash-exl3-400k

model.quantization: exl3-4bit routed experts; q4 dense; fp8 KV

container.name: tensorfold-glm53-400k-p8-20261106t165335
container.gpus: all 4 NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3; one rank per GPU
container.name_note: Replacement for the context/concurrency change; same immutable validated image. Previous serving container preserved stopped with restart=no.

recipe.adaptation: H100 per-rank device selector baked into image; exact context-only reconciliation of upstream patches 0117 and 0119; immutable supervisor entrypoint.

observed.phase: startup health/model/context checks only; no inference tests or workload qualification

post_validation.phase: healthy idle after bounded validation; no restart or cache flush

memory_profile.reason: Host dedicated to inference; operator requested reducing idle free HBM from 17-18 GiB to about 8-10 GiB.
memory_profile.note: Historical calibration belongs to earlier serving windows/settings. Current per-request context is 400000 and maximum concurrency is 8; pool cap 22.5 GiB and reserve 5 GiB are unchanged. The shared pool is sized automatically; see observed.pool_tokens and the change evidence. Startup free-memory samples are not workload peaks or an eight-concurrent-request qualification. October 31 long/mixed and 1M measurements remain historical, not measurements of the current 400k/8-stream configuration.

platform_notes: The published recipe image is linux/arm64; this host runs a locally built linux/amd64 image from the same TensorFold v0.6.0 + patches.
start.sh targets 2-3 DGX Sparks over SSH/RoCE; this host runs one container with four ranks, one GPU each, all GPUs visible for NCCL/NVLink.
The NGC image sets NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=spcx (Spectrum-X); this non-RDMA host requires NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=none and NCCL_GIN_ENABLE=0.
The new image bakes the TF_GLM_DEVICE selector into the engine; the supervisor does not modify source on restart.
The old external deployment project is retained as rollback history. Its config.env and remove/recreate launch scripts are not the current deployment authority; use this profile and the GLM runbook.

rollback.restore: After approved idle/drain: set current serving container restart=no and stop it; start this preserved previous serving container and set unless-stopped; verify parsed health/model/context=1048576/streams=4; update production record to match rollback.
rollback.note: Previous production settings; rollback restores the 1M context and four-stream limit, not the new 400k/8-stream settings.

secondary_fallback.note: Separate Qwen fallback, not the primary rollback for this GLM update. Never run alongside a GLM service on these GPUs.

promotion.known_pre_promotion_timing_caveat: One matched cold 1M pair measured 186.467 s new vs 175.308 s old (+6.37% TTFT). Operator explicitly selected monitored promotion after disclosure; cause/statistical confidence not established.
promotion.benchmark_status: complete: all 14 capacity workloads plus one mixed workload passed; isolated traffic, no observed OOM or container restart
promotion.timing_followup: Earlier +6.37% single-pair slowdown was not reproduced in two fresh prompt-cold post-promotion requests. Compiled kernel cache was reused; no cause or statistical confidence established. Continue monitoring.

qualification: 400k/8-stream bounded screening passed: interfaces, actual eight-way short/cached/sampled decoding, two near-390k retrievals, context refusals, mixed 200k prefill/decode and a 120-request 662.8-second varied-shape soak. 212 requests across separately isolated passing phases including eight warmups, plus two expected refusals. No new OOM/fatal rank markers or restarts in final run; later soak idle memory flat. 149 offline repository tests pass. Not a multi-day memory-growth fix, eight simultaneous near-limit contexts, full-quality, gateway or tail-latency qualification. Historical 1M/4-stream image benchmarks remain separate.

configuration_change.request_limit_semantics: 400000 tokens total per request, prompt plus reply; not a cumulative per-user quota. Shared pool spans concurrent requests and cached prompts.
configuration_change.note: Maximum stream capacity is configured, not a measurement of actual simultaneous decoding or throughput. Historical promotion benchmarks below used the previous 1M/4-stream settings.
